product_updates.content: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

product_updates.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
product_updates.content: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during Q3 earnings. The AI app now has over 10M users.

product_updates.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
product_updates.content: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

product_updates.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
product_updates.content: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

product_updates.title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
product_updates.content: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

product_updates.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
